bank._source: our choice (D1): equal n for every source because kNN similarities depend on bank size; smallest corpus is NFCorpus (3,633). The n=1000 bank is the first 1,000 of the same seeded permutation (nested)

scores._source: k=10 our choice (same as P4 KNN k). A3 (doc Energy / MSP) reported over the tau grid only, no primary tau (D2: Qwen3 training temperature not confirmed; A3 is auxiliary)

redde._source: Si & Callan, SIGIR 2003, modified ReDDE (Sec. 4, Eq. 11-14): r1 = 0.0005, r2 = 0.003, backoff 0.1. Our adaptations: centralized sample DB = union of the known sources' banks ranked by the retriever's dense score (paper: INQUERY); uniform random samples (paper: query-based sampling); exact corpus sizes (paper: sample-resample estimates). Routing only (ReDDE has no rejection rule)
